Container.Name: tzdelay
Container.Overview: Timezone delay for radio. Takes a live HLS audio stream and plays it out again a set time later. Add stations and set delays in the web page.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web page, API and delayed streams

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stations and buffered audio. About 58 MB per hour of delay per station at 128 kbps. Keep on persistent storage.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Only affects log timestamps; delays are timezone-independent
